title: Resin Labels: Durable 3D Logos | VAM Deco
description: Resin domed labels with a glossy 3D effect: logos resistant to water, scratches and UV. Custom-made in Ticino, request a quote.
h1: Resin Labels: Raised Logos with a 3D Effect
estratto: Stickers finished with a domed layer of resin that gives your logo a glossy 3D effect, resistant to water, scratches and sunlight.

paragrafi: Resin labels, also known as domed stickers, are decals coated with a layer of clear resin that creates a glossy three-dimensional effect. They give your logo a premium look and protect it from scratches, water and sunlight for years.

sezioni.heading: What resin labels are
paragrafi: They are high-definition printed stickers onto which a layer of two-component polyurethane resin is poured. Once cured, the resin becomes one with the label and creates its signature domed effect.
The result is an elegant, highly durable label, perfect for businesses, artisans, products and promotional gadgets. A detail that instantly signals quality and care.

sezioni.heading: Why choose them
lista: 3D effect and premium look: the raised resin adds depth and shine to your logo.
Durability of up to around 8 years, even outdoors: waterproof and resistant to scratches, weathering and UV rays, without fading.
They stick to plastic, glass, metal and wood with a strong, long-lasting hold.
Full customization: bespoke shapes, vivid colors and glossy or metallic finishes.

sezioni.heading: Where they are used
lista: Promotional gadgets: pens, USB sticks, keyrings and accessories.
Products and packaging: bottles, boxes and handmade items.
Electronics and vehicles: they withstand heat and chemicals.
Equipment and machinery: long-lasting identification in industrial settings.
Fashion and design: logos on accessories and high-end items.

sezioni.heading: Custom resin labels in Ticino
paragrafi: At VAM Deco we produce custom resin labels using high-quality resins and high-definition printing, carefully choosing the shape, colors and finish that best suit your brand.
Want to elevate your logo with a detail that lasts? Get in touch for a free, no-obligation quote.

faq.risposta: They are custom stickers covered with a layer of clear resin that creates a domed, glossy 3D effect. The resin protects the logo and enhances its colors.

faq.domanda: How long do resin labels last?
faq.risposta: The two-component polyurethane resin ensures excellent hold even outdoors, up to around 8 years, without fading or yellowing. Indoors they last even longer.

faq.domanda: Which surfaces can they be applied to?
faq.risposta: They adhere well to plastic, glass, metal and wood. All it takes is a clean, degreased surface for a strong, long-lasting hold.

faq.domanda: Are they resistant to water and sunlight?
faq.risposta: Yes. They are waterproof and resistant to scratches, UV rays and weathering, making them suitable for outdoor use on products, gadgets and vehicles too.

faq.domanda: How much do they cost and how do I request a quote?
faq.risposta: The price depends on the quantity, size, shape and colors you choose. Send us these details and we will prepare a custom quote for you, free and with no obligation.
